items.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Scene upper third: after class in a warm classroom, adult female player with brown bun and cream cardigan stands holding a notebook near teacher's desk; teacher is tidying lecture handouts and warmly attends to player who is about to ask a question. Teacher clearly mature adult40s, casual academic outfit. No speech bubbles that invent dialogue, no other students, no children, no diploma, no money. Beneath show exactly three equal icon cells "自由时间−1小时", "压力−3", "亲密度＋3". Pressure icon a little gently relaxing cloud/face, not battery; no energy effects. B panel label EXACT "B 先记下来，回去自己看看". B has no effect cells and no "不变" or "无数值变化". Do not add happiness, energy, XP, money, academic progress or teacher-gate hints. No explanatory limits or extra footer; no watermark or screenshot claims. Compact A panel, B close below it, minimal bottom padding.
